Purchase Quote — Edit

The Purchase Quote form allows you to record and manage quotations received from suppliers, helping you compare prices and terms before making purchasing decisions.

Purchase quotes are essential for procurement management, enabling you to evaluate multiple supplier offers, negotiate better terms, and maintain a documented history of pricing proposals. You can easily convert accepted quotes into Purchase Orders or Purchase Invoices when you're ready to proceed with the purchase.

When entering a purchase quote, include all relevant details such as item descriptions, quantities, unit prices, and any special terms or conditions. You can mark quotes as 'Request for Quotation' if you're soliciting prices from suppliers. The status tracking helps you identify which quotes have been accepted and converted to actual purchases.

Date

Enter the date of the purchase quote. This is typically when the quote was received from or sent to the supplier.

Reference

Enter a reference number for this quote. This could be the supplier's quote number or your RFQ reference.

Supplier

Select the supplier who provided this quote or to whom you're sending a request for quotation.

Description

Optionally, add a description or notes about this quote, such as special terms, validity period, or requirements.

Lines

Enter the items being quoted. Each line includes the item, quantity, unit price (if known), and descriptions.

Request for quotation

Check this box if this is a request for quotation (RFQ) being sent to suppliers, rather than a quote received from them.

Amounts are tax inclusive

Check this box if the quoted prices already include tax. Leave unchecked if tax is added on top of the quoted prices.

Column — Line number

Check this box to display line numbers on the quote. This helps reference specific items when discussing with suppliers.

Column — Discount

Check this box to enable a discount column for recording any discounts offered by the supplier.

DiscountType

Select whether discounts are entered as percentages or fixed amounts.

Withholding tax

Check this box if withholding tax applies to this purchase. This affects the final amount payable to the supplier.

Cancelled

This indicates whether the quote has been cancelled. Cancelled quotes remain in the system for record-keeping but are marked as inactive.
